$comment: Sources the NowBey alerts engine polls for missing-person & Marco's Alert notices.
Two network layers run alongside wire/bulletins.json + POST /api/alerts:
1. sources      -> verified live Bahamian newsroom RSS feeds, filtered through
isAlertCandidate() so only missing-person / RBPF advisories pass.
2. alertQueries -> Google News RSS queries scoped to Marco's Alert & missing persons
Operators can also set RBPF_FB_RSS_URL (an RSS-Bridge / rss.app feed for the Royal
Bahamas Police Force Facebook page) or ALERTS_EXTRA_FEEDS in environment variables.

alertQueries.label: Marco's Alert notices
alertQueries.query: "Marco's Alert" OR "MARCO Alert" OR "502-9991" OR "if seen contact police" Bahamas

alertQueries.label: Missing person advisories
alertQueries.query: ("reported missing" OR "missing child" OR "missing teen" OR "missing girl" OR "missing boy" OR "missing person") Bahamas

alertQueries.label: RBPF public safety bulletins
alertQueries.query: "Royal Bahamas Police Force" ("missing" OR "last seen" OR "wanted")
